_source: Bearman, P. W. & Harvey, J. K. (1976). Golf ball aerodynamics. Aeronautical Quarterly, 27(2), 112-122.
_notes: Cd values are for a standard dimpled golf ball (diameter ~42.67 mm).
Reynolds number Re = rho * v * D / mu, D = ball diameter.
Pre-crisis plateau: laminar boundary layer, Cd ~ 0.50.
Crisis region (Re 4e4 - 8e4): boundary layer trips turbulent due to dimples.
Slight Cd recovery above Re=1e5 before settling to turbulent plateau.
Values digitised from Figure 3, Bearman & Harvey 1976.
